findings.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
findings.summary: 138k press releases 2005-2023. FinBERT SHAP 52% vs EPS surprise 48%. L/S yields negative alpha (market efficient at open). Self-serving bias pattern exploitable. Combined hard+soft signals: 52% precision for top-10 vs 25-36% single signal.
findings.reason: DIRECTLY upgrades H163/H174 documentation. Attribution bias = new feature for H274. Confirms overnight gap entry rationale. STAGED as proposal 4.

findings.title: Predicting Stock Price Direction on Earnings Announcement Days using Multi-modal Deep Learning
findings.summary: 3-modality model: fundamentals + technicals + FinBERT news sentiment. LSTM = precision, Transformer = recall. Sentiment ablation shows consistent lift.
findings.reason: Supports multi-modal signal approach. LSTM precision conservative strategy aligns with H163/H174 high-WR low-trade approach. Design input for H274. Not staging separately — covered by H274.

findings.title: ChatGPT in Systematic Investing: Enhancing Risk-Adjusted Returns with LLMs
findings.summary: LLM-enhanced systematic investing; PEAD and disclosure frictions create predictability opportunities.
findings.reason: General LLM investing overview. Nothing novel beyond existing wiki content.

findings.title: Machine Learning Enhanced Multi-Factor Quantitative Trading: A Cross-Sectional Portfolio Optimization Approach with Bias Correction
findings.summary: Mask-first design prevents upstream contamination from non-tradable prices. +0.44 Sharpe improvement from this fix alone. Adjusted-MSE loss (sign penalty 11x). Sharpe 2.05 synthetic / 1.63 real A-share. Deflated Sharpe 0.978.
findings.reason: The mask-first principle applies to US equities (halted stocks, penny stocks). Our H198/H217/H228 momentum pipelines may be inflating IC. The adjusted-MSE loss is useful for any ML signal training. STAGED as proposal 2 (wiki update to momentum-strategies.md).

findings.title: Dynamic Inclusion and Bounded Multi-Factor Tilts for Robust Portfolio Construction
findings.summary: Multi-factor tilts (momentum, value, quality) with bounded exposure. Cross-sectional standardization at each rebalance.
findings.reason: Portfolio construction improvements. Our current blend approach (H026+H041a+H045+IBS) already achieves multi-factor. Not a new hypothesis.

findings.title: Measuring Strategy-Decay Risk: Minimum Regime Performance and the Durability of Systematic Investing
findings.summary: MRP = lowest risk-adjusted return across regimes. High Sharpe ≠ high MRP. Strategies with high aggregate Sharpe can fail badly in specific regimes.
findings.reason: MRP is a missing metric in our confirmation criteria. Directly applicable to production portfolio durability assessment. STAGED as proposal 3.

findings.title: Not All Factors Crowd Equally: Modeling, Measuring, and Trading on Alpha Decay
findings.summary: 50% of anomaly alpha disappears post-publication. Mechanical factors (momentum) crowd faster than judgment factors (value). Models predict crowding.
findings.reason: Relevant to signal-halflife.md wiki. The momentum-crowds-faster finding is a warning for H198/H217. Already partially covered in signal-halflife.md but MRP-specific crowding model not in wiki.

findings.title: Toward Expert Investment Teams: A Multi-Agent LLM System with Fine-Grained Trading Tasks
findings.summary: Fine-grained task decomposition > coarse role mimicry. Oxford/Kyoto. Japanese equities. Leakage-controlled backtesting. Alignment between analytical outputs and downstream decision preferences is critical.
findings.reason: Best design template for H274 multi-agent PEAD upgrade. Rare: leakage-controlled backtesting standard. STAGED as core input for proposal 1 (H274). Added to new wiki page.

findings.title: HedgeAgents: A Balanced-aware Multi-agent Financial Trading System
findings.summary: Fund manager + 3 domain experts (crypto/equity/forex). Annualized 71.6%, Sharpe 2.41, MaxDD 14.21% over 2021-2023. 3 conference coordination types.
findings.reason: Architecture worth studying despite caveated performance (2021-2023 crypto bubble). Budget allocation + experience sharing conferences are interesting coordination patterns. Added to wiki page.

findings.title: Toward Reliable Evaluation of LLM-Based Financial Multi-Agent Systems
findings.summary: 5 evaluation failures that reverse return sign. Coordination Primacy Hypothesis. CBS metric. Four-dimensional taxonomy (architecture, coordination, memory, tools).
findings.reason: Critical reliability framework. CBS metric is directly useful for our pipeline. STAGED as part of H274 context and added to wiki page. Must apply to any future multi-agent papers.

findings.title: When Agents Trade: Live Multi-Market Trading Benchmark for LLM Agents
findings.summary: Agent Market Arena: first lifelong real-time benchmark. Framework architecture > LLM backbone for behavioral variation. GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, Claude-3.5-Haiku, Claude-Sonnet-4, Gemini-2.0-Flash tested.
findings.reason: Validates that framework design matters more than model choice. Directly informs H274 design decision (any LLM provider will work). Added to wiki page.

findings.title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
findings.summary: 7-agent framework (analysts + traders + risk). 84.9k GitHub stars. Apache-2.0. yfinance data. Available pip package. Cumulative return, Sharpe, MaxDD improvements over baselines.
findings.reason: Most-starred quant AI repo. Direct input for H274 implementation. Already has pip install. Added to wiki page.

findings.title: NautilusTrader
findings.summary: Rust core + Python strategies. Nanosecond backtest. 20+ live venues (Kraken native, IBKR, Binance, Polymarket). Identical strategy code research→production. 23.4k stars.
findings.reason: Production-grade execution engine for when we move beyond Alpaca. Kraken native integration is directly relevant (Kevin has Kraken account). H276 execution POC designed. Added to wiki page.

findings.title: OpenBB

findings.reason: Data infrastructure. Already have polygon/FRED/Alpaca/FMP keys working directly. OpenBB adds complexity without clear benefit for our current pipeline.
